Households by UK-wide £5,000 band of baseline household net income in 2027-28 (income_basis_year 2027) and income change band (contract change_edges: an exact-zero band from -£1 to £1, edges at ±1, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 750, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 3,000 and 5,000, open beyond ±£5,000), by measure, package and year (2027-2031), from generate --only household_scatter on Microcosm UK 2024-25 national build microcosm-uk-2024-25-national-20261019T083323Z-6cba5d71 (policyengine 6.10.2, policyengine-uk 2.132.6). Every year's households are banded by their 2027-28 baseline income, so an income band holds the same households in each year and each year's cells count them at that year's weight; year-to-year differences within a band are the uprating of its households' weights plus the weights of households that changed change band, covered by the same floor and rounding as differences between cells. No household rows: cells with fewer than 10 distinct survey households (source_household_id) are left out and counts are rounded to the nearest 1,000. On the nine candidate Autumn Budget 2026 measures and their combined run (candidates modelled before the Budget, not announced policy), regenerated on Budget day. No area below the UK. Warm Home Discount top-up and combined rows regenerated on 24 October with DESNZ receipt rates (85% Pension Credit, 70% other; mirrors policyengine-uk #2616), winter 2026-27; pending review. Warm Home Discount top-up and combined rows regenerated on 25 October with the 2026-27 core group (Universal Credit, Pension Credit, Housing Benefit, income-related ESA; policyengine-uk #2504); pending review.
